title: ZIBENS: drum-synth machine
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: ZIBENS (Latvian for lightning), a drum-synth SRC machine laid out like a four-voice drum synth: VOIC picks KICK, LOW, SNARE or HATS, ALGO one of three algorithms for it (808, FM, PNCH; TOM, RES, ZAP; SNR, CLAP, METL; HAT, NOIS, BIT), PRM1 and PRM2 its two parameters, then decay and drive. Page 2: pitch envelope and its decay, a gritty bucket-brigade-style delay (send, time up to 340 ms, feedback) and a compressor, with DEC again and VIEW, a picture of the envelopes. VOIC draws the drum it plays. Machine 34. Needs machine-pages 1.5 or newer and core 4.4.
